gotham.scope: Every processed/*.csv member; raw PCAPs excluded
gotham.download_method: HTTP byte ranges for the CSV members and ZIP central directory
gotham.integrity: Each processed CSV was decompressed through zipfile, which checks its ZIP CRC. The full original archive MD5 was not verified because the raw PCAP ranges were not downloaded.

bccc.status: All 246 CSV members in the two dedicated CSV archives measured; PCAP-area sources documented separately
bccc.download_method: HTTP byte ranges covering every CSV member and the ZIP central directories
bccc.integrity: Every complete CSV member was decompressed through Python zipfile and its ZIP CRC checked. Whole original archive checksums were not compared with a publisher checksum.
